[PREFERENCE] User is looking for tips on how to style a pair of distressed denim jeans.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on redeeming the gift card and acknowledged their loyalty to Trendy Wear.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for styling distressed denim jeans, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Balance the distress with a polished top.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Add a statement top to draw attention away from distressed areas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Play with textures by mixing different materials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Emphasize the waist with a belted top or high-waisted jeans.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Add shine with metallic accessories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Keep accessories simple to let the denim be the focal point.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Experiment with different shoe styles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested popular ways to style distressed denim jeans, including pairing with a graphic tee and sneakers, a flowy blouse and heeled ankle boots, or a denim jacket and band tee.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering buying a new top to go with their distressed denim jeans.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Pair it with casual shoes.
